title: Threads: public Message threads data and the threads include, read-only, authors as public handles
description:
Phase 6 of the `homePage` epic: Message threads, read-only, as a list or grid. Unblocked 2026-10-31: authors are opt-in public handles (the public handle task), otherwise a role label.

## Goal
`_data/home-page/threads.json` lists recent public conversation threads (anchored on a public Reference or a published Story) with a title, anchor, counts, last activity and the latest Message's text; `::include{kind="threads" select="recent" count="8" layout="list|grid"}` renders them. Per-thread files `_data/home-page/threads/<key>.json` (messages in sequence) are written too, as the seam for the later forum pages, but no page reads them yet.

## Public rule
A thread is public when: `threadKind in (reference_conversation, story_conversation)`, `status == active`, and its anchor is public: `primaryAnchorKey == reference#<lineageId>` whose public key is in the current `references.json` (accepted or recommended), or `item#<lineageId>` with a `PublishedItem` `status == published`. Unanchored `conversation` threads are not public. A Message is public when `status == active` and `messageKind == comment`; deleted Messages are omitted entirely (their text remains in DynamoDB after soft delete). Public Message fields: `key` (sha256 of id, 12 hex), `at` (`createdAt`), `edited` (bool from `editedAt`), `text` (`content`, rendered through the same Markdown pipeline as item bodies, with raw HTML stripped), `author`: `{"handle": h}` when the author's `UserProfile.publicHandle` is set (join `authorUserProfileId` -> `get_record("UserProfile", id)` with the IAM client; cache per run; read nothing else of the profile), else `{"label": homePage.threads.anonymousLabel}` (default "Editor"; "AI" when `role != "human"`). `homePage.threads.authors` is `"handle"` (default) or `"none"` (label only). Never written: `authorSub`, `authorUserProfileId`, `authorLabel`, `deletedBySub`, `createdBySub`, `createdByLabel`, `metadata.lastAuthorLabel`, `responseOwner`, any id.

## Files to create / change
- `src/papyrus_content/home_page/threads.py`: `collect_threads(client, public_reference_keys, settings)`: `client.list_by_index("messageThreadsByKindAndUpdatedAt", kind)` for the two kinds (register both plus `messagesByThreadAndSequence` in `graphql_authoring.INDEX_DEFINITIONS`; `MESSAGE_FIELDS` gains `editedAt`, `deletedAt`, `deletedBySub` if the snapshot task did not), then `list_by_index("messagesByThreadAndSequence", threadId)` per thread; `public_thread(...)`, `public_message(...)`.
- `src/papyrus_content/home_page/snapshot.py`: `build_threads_snapshot(...)` -> `threads.json` `{"generatedAt", "threads": [{"key", "title", "anchor": {"kind": "reference"|"story", "key"|"url", "title"}, "messages": n, "lastAt", "latest": {message}}]}` sorted by `lastAt` desc, and one `threads/<key>.json` per thread `{"key", "title", "anchor", "messages": [...]}`.
- `src/papyrus_content/home_page/task.py`: `run_home_page_snapshot` writes threads files when `settings.threads.enabled`; per-file change rule as before; stale `threads/<key>.json` of threads no longer public are deleted (the task owns `_data/home-page/threads/`).
- `standard/home_page_blocks.py`: `kind="threads"` with `ATTRIBUTES = {"select", "count", "layout", "heading", "empty"}`, `select` only `recent` for now; ledger key `thread:<key>`; card: anchor eyebrow (Lucide `link` for a Reference, `file-text` for a Story), title, "N messages" with a `message-square` icon, `<time>` of `lastAt`, the latest message text clipped at a sentence boundary (`summary_characters` rule from `public_data.py`), author per policy.
- `standard/home_page.py` `HomePageSource.threads()`, digest includes `threads.json`.
- `standard/blocks.py twin()` keeps `kind="threads"` lines.
- Freshness: `amplify/plugins/home-page/papyrus.plugin.ts` adds the Message table stream to the same trigger when `threads.enabled` (the Message cfn table lookup already exists in `site-backend.ts`; do not create a second stream when the console responder already enabled one: read `tableStreamArn` first). Trigger change filter for Messages: `status`, `content`, `editedAt`, `deletedAt`.
- `features_backend/home-page-threads.feature` + steps; fixture threads with one deleted Message, one unanchored thread, one thread on a rejected Reference, one thread on a published Story, one `authorLabel` that is an email.

## Gherkin scenarios
- "Threads on accepted References and published Stories are public; unanchored threads and threads on rejected References are not"
- "A deleted Message is omitted entirely, and the thread's count excludes it"
- "An author with a public handle is shown by that handle; one without is shown as Editor; no email, sub or UUID appears anywhere" (identity_leaks scan)
- "With authors none, every author is shown by the anonymous label"
- "A page lists the most recently active threads as a list, and as a grid"
- "A threads include never repeats a thread already placed on the page"
- "Posting a Message schedules one snapshot at the end of the debounce window"
- "A thread that stops being public has its per-thread file deleted"
- "The Markdown twin keeps the threads include line as written"

## Acceptance checks
- behave + unit tests green; `identity_leaks` finds nothing in any fixture output.
- On Anth.us: add `"threads": {"enabled": true}` and a `::include{kind="threads" select="recent" count="8" layout="list"}` band to `web/pages/newsroom.md` (site PR), bump the version, verify https://anth.us/newsroom/.

## Dependencies
Depends on: home-page snapshot, references include, freshness, the public handle task. Blocks: docs; the later conversation epic.
